summary: The ordinary path is LOCAL_RESEARCH/REAL_TIME, never a renamed FIXTURE. Supply three complete explicit policy documents under the local data root and an absolute operator selection outside cloud staging. configure-paper dispatches to configure_ordinary_paper, verifies native installation/receipt through a bounded owned check, parses policies and the accepted original package, then appends a protected selection. Identical bytes reuse the generation; changes create a new generation. This configures no run and grants no financial authority. No independent WorkflowPolicy JSON/class was found: Paper workflow uses the selection boolean, actor and policy reference; unattended scheduling has a separate closed operations profile. run-product may launch the runtime role but its scheduler never commands PaperStart. A normal authenticated PaperStart must separately name the selected policy and actual candidate, revision and command ID; candidate risk hash must equal the selected risk policy. PUBLIC_MARKET must be independently configured with explicit keyless read authorization. Native currentness, exact policies/package/receipt/config, non-restored status, temporal validity, market availability, E6 workflow and E5 risk remain gates. Public feed I/O runs in an owned child outside worker.tick; owner-thread immutable subscriptions fence runtime/E6 generations. Expired/stale/replaced selection denies new exposure while original obligations retain original management configuration. No thresholds, policy identities or actor/account choices are recommended here.

Who is the local Paper workflow actor, which isolated simulated account reference and policy reference identify this authorization, and is workflow_authorized explicitly intended true now or false for idle commissioning?

What explicit E5 capital/exposure/loss/count/age/hold/plan limits and promotion elapsed/trade/profit/drawdown/loss/health/gap thresholds are authorized, with version/generation and null-profit-factor handling?
What poll/cache/currentness/action/protection intervals are intended, and does cache capacity cover actual strategy warmup?
Should keyless OKX_PUBLIC BTC reads be enabled, and which unattended roles, scan/research/report switches and restart bounds are selected?
minimum_prestart_checks: Use verified native installed entrypoint; unchanged owning config/data/instance, LOCAL_RESEARCH, diagnostic_only=false, paper_runtime_enabled=true; disjoint local/cloud roots and non-restored state.
Stop all product roles before configure-paper/configure-market-data; preserve actual receipt and prior append-only selection history. Never edit database rows or copy fixture policy values.

Validate all explicit policy documents and original manifest validity; compare candidate namespace, identity/content and selected risk hash. Public engineering diagnostic research is not automatically a candidate or forward qualification.

Verify independent current native runtime/receipt observation, actual fresh ticker, finalized contiguous received-at candles and sufficient selected timeframes/warmup. Missing market profile remains NOT_CONNECTED.

Start only selected services via one run-product coordinator; use authenticated normal PaperStart with current expected_revision and stable command_id. Check actual owner acknowledgment/protection rather than inferring execution from startup.

Receipt/config/input/selection changes, expired tactical validity, stale market or observation, restored copy and missing eligibility block new exposure; preserve original protective management and reassess through owners before new starts.

runtime_bounds.native_observation: release_observation.MAX_AGE_SECONDS=30; fresh independently verified observation required, no permanent cached PASS. Full installed/input/receipt verification stays in owned observer, not hot protective loop.
runtime_bounds.public_child: public_feed.DEADLINE=125 seconds, owned resource limits and bounded output/reap; background acquisition thread, owner takes completed immutable batch only; capture retention refuses at 86400 batches or 1GiB per runtime rather than silently deleting history.
runtime_bounds.market: event_for requires actual OKX ticker HEALTHY, observed<=received<=now, age<=5s and freshness_ms<=5000, monotonically advancing observations; engine additionally applies selected market_max_age_seconds. This fixed producer bound is not an operator recommendation.
runtime_bounds.warmup: Owner subscription uses actual required_timeframes, expression minimum_history+1 capped by selected capacity (max4000), last durable close and run/content/runtime/E6 generation fences. Closed contiguous aligned candles must be available by received_at; boundary crossing during acquisition is retried. Operator must not assume a too-small cache provides warmup.
runtime_bounds.protection: Stale/missing market or expired entry eligibility does not grant new fills. Original selection/release/risk commitments are recovered for accepted obligations; replacement workflow permission does not transfer to old runs.
